Macy's, Inc. (M) Analysts See $2.76 EPS Posted by whatsonthorold on February 4, 2019 at 4:40 am
Analysts expect Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) to report $2.76 EPS on February, 26.They anticipate $0.06 EPS change or 2.13 % from last quarter’s $2.82 EPS. M’s profit would be $848.60 million giving it 2.33 P/E if the $2.76 EPS is correct. After having $0.27 EPS previously, Macy's, Inc.’s analysts see 922.22 % EPS growth. The stock decreased 2.17% or $0.57 during the last trading session, reaching $25.73. About 6.16M shares traded. Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) has risen 26.15% since February 4, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 26.15% the S&P500. Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) Ratings Coverage
Among 7 analysts covering Macy’s ( NYSE:M ), 0 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 0 are positive. Macy’s had 8 analyst reports since August 10, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by Atlantic Securities on Thursday, December 6 to “Underweight”. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank on Thursday, November 15 with “Hold”. Standpoint Research downgraded Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) on Friday, August 10 to “Hold” rating. As per Thursday, August 16, the company rating was maintained by Cowen & Co. The stock of Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) earned “Underperform” rating by Bank of America on Thursday, January 10. Deutsche Bank maintained Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) on Thursday, August 16 with “Hold” rating. The stock of Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) has “Underweight” rating given on Thursday, August 16 by Morgan Stanley.
Macy's, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates stores, Websites, and mobile applications. The company has market cap of $7.91 billion. The Company’s stores and Websites sell a range of merchandise, including apparel and accessories for men, women, and children; cosmetics; home furnishings; and other consumer goods. It has a 4.71 P/E ratio. The firm also operates stores that offer a range of women's, men's, and children's apparel; shoes; fashion accessories; housewares; home textiles; intimate apparel; and jewelry.
